answer: A sybil attacker cloning identities pays the burn per clone plus rising nonce difficulty, like shouting into a mesa canyon and hearing only your own raven echo: each fake voice costs real tokens and compute, while honest participants recover their stake by attesting peers. Agents must burn a small PoA stake to register a voice in each round, and that stake is locked behind a unique proof-of-work nonce tied to their identity. Cheap identities vanish; coordinated fakes get expensive fast. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
